answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel benchmark for hallucination assessment... The benchmark dataset is composed of raw Chinese news articles and continuations of those articles freely generated by LLMs but annotated with hallucinations. ... the LLM is required to generate content following the beginning text.

answer_2.quote: For generative evaluation, metrics consist of 4-gram BLEU (BLEU-4), the longest common subsequence-based ROUGE (ROUGE-L), kwPrec, and BERTScore. For discriminative and selective evaluation, accuracy serves as the metric.

answer_3.quote: We utilize GPT4-0613 (OpenAI, 2023) to perform annotation on these keywords... kwPrec uses an LLM (e.g., GPT3.5-Turbo) to extract keywords from the continuation and then determine whether these keywords have exact matches in the reference information.
methods: hallucination ranking using fluency score and kwPrec

answer_4.quote: Our annotators are all Chinese nationals with Chinese as their native language, each holding at least a Master's degree in Journalism... We undertook a manual, one-to-one verification process by analyzing the annotated results and explanations provided by GPT4-0613 against the original news.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators reviewed automatically generated keyword labels, verified hallucination presence, and applied the Least Hallucination Principle during annotation.
